# Gaurav Kumar — Full-Stack Developer (Extended Profile)

## Identity
- **Full name:** Gaurav Kumar (also known as Gaurav Thakur)
- **Role:** Full-stack developer
- **Current organization:** B3 Solution
- **Location:** Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, India (postal code 174001)
- **Time zone:** IST / UTC+5:30
- **Languages:** English (professional), Hindi (native)
- **Site:** https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/

## Professional summary
Full-stack developer with 1.5+ years of professional experience building production
React + Node applications. Specialised in two verticals:

1. **Finance dashboards** — built four production dashboards in nine months
   covering P&L (by entity), AR aging, reconciliation, and expense automation.
   Combined impact: 70% reduction in weekly reporting time and 60%+ workflow
   automation across the team.

2. **Amazon advertising analytics** — built and maintains a seven-page Amazon
   India advertising analytics platform tracking ACOS, ROAS, CPC, and ad spend
   across 18 ASINs and 3,500+ keywords. Uses Puppeteer Stealth to scrape Amazon
   Seller Central weekly, stores rank history in PostgreSQL, exposes data via a
   Next.js dashboard.

Engagement style: end-to-end ownership from architecture decisions through
deployment, async-first remote collaboration, clear written communication,
quiet focus on the small architectural choices that decide whether a tool
actually gets used.

## Technology stack

### Frontend
React (5 years equivalent depth), Next.js (App Router + Pages Router),
TypeScript, JavaScript (ES2020+), Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query,
React Query, Vite, Webpack, plain HTML/CSS.

### Backend
Node.js, Express, Prisma, REST API design, JWT authentication, HTTP-only
cookie session patterns, GraphQL (Apollo Server).

### Data
PostgreSQL (window functions, materialised views, denormalised reporting
views), MongoDB (TTL indexes, aggregation pipelines), Redis (caching + queues),
schema design for analytics workloads.

### Scraping / Automation
Puppeteer, puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth, browser automation against
authenticated SaaS UIs, cron-driven workers, captcha mitigation strategies,
audit logging for scraped data.

### Infrastructure
Docker (multi-stage builds), Vercel deployment, GitHub Actions CI, VPS
deployment (single-server setups), Turborepo monorepos.

### Design / Tooling
Figma (consuming designs, not original design work), Git, Linux/macOS
command line, Postman/Insomnia, Chrome DevTools.

## Notable projects (verifiable)

### Amazon India Analytics Dashboard
- **Type:** B3 Solution flagship product
- **Stack:** Next.js + Node.js + PostgreSQL + Puppeteer Stealth
- **Scope:** Seven pages — Ad Reports, Keyword Rank, ASIN Performance, ACOS
  Tracking, Weekly Comparison, Category Tools, User Management
- **Scale:** 18 ASINs, 3,500+ tracked keywords, weekly scraping cadence
- **Impact:** Replaced 3–4 hours of manual VLOOKUPs every Monday with 5
  minutes of dashboard review
- **Page:** https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/work/amazon-analytics/
- **Writeup:** https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/blog/amazon-analytics-puppeteer-postgres.html

### Finance dashboards (four projects)
- **Type:** B3 Solution client work
- **Stack:** React + Node + PostgreSQL
- **Scope:** P&L by entity, AR aging, reconciliation, expense automation
- **Reusable patterns:** denormalised reporting views, freshness badge,
  server-side aggregation with browser filtering, CSV export, audit log
- **Impact:** 70% reduction in weekly reporting time, 60%+ workflow
  automation across the team
- **Page:** https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/work/finance-dashboards/
- **Writeup:** https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/blog/finance-dashboards-playbook.html

### NeoMail — Email client
- **Type:** Personal project
- **Stack:** MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) + Redux Toolkit
- **Notable features:** JWT HTTP-only cookie auth (not localStorage), MongoDB

- **Demo:** https://neomail-frontend.vercel.app
- **Case study:** https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/work/neomail/

## Engagement model

### Project types accepted
- Custom dashboard development (finance, analytics, ops)
- Amazon Seller Central scraping + analytics platforms
- Full-stack MERN product builds end-to-end
- Existing React + Node codebase work (features, refactors)

### Project types declined
- Pure design work (consume Figma, don't originate)
- WordPress / no-code platform work
- Mobile-native (React Native is OK case-by-case)
- ML model training (basic AI/Python integration OK)

### Typical engagement
- 30-minute scoping call to define scope and constraints
- Fixed-price for well-scoped builds, hourly for ongoing collaboration
- Weekly demo + written status update during active sprints
- Async-first communication, expects 4–6 hours of timezone overlap minimum
